q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer:
**Top 5 Best‑Selling Genres (by total sales)**  

| Rank | Genre               | Total Sales (USD) |
|------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 1    | Rock                | $826.65 |
| 2    | Latin               | $382.14 |
| 3    | Metal               | $261.36 |
| 4    | Alternative & Punk | $241.56 |
| 5    | TV Shows            | $93.53 |

These figures are calculated by summing the line‑item revenue (`UnitPrice × Quantity`) for every track sold, grouped by the track’s genre.

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_004.answer: The most popular media type, based on the number of tracks, is **“MPEG audio file”** with **3,034 tracks**.

q_005.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_005.answer: The employee with the most customers assigned is **Jane Peacock** (Employee Id 3) – she has **21** customers.

q_009.sql:
WITH cust_spending AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spending
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
)
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, total_spending,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spending DESC) AS rank
FROM cust_spending
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer:
**Top 5 customers by total spending**

| Rank | CustomerId | First Name | Last Name | Total Spending |

*Ranks are calculated using `RANK()`, so ties share the same rank (e.g., customers 45 and 46 are tied for 4th place).*

q_010.sql:
SELECT ar.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY GenreCount DESC, ArtistName;
